# Fairytwinkle (effect 51) on palette Rainbow at speed 128, intensity 128, colour slots red, black
# and green, captured from the south controller on segment 2 on 2026-09-27. Not a raw frame: each LED
# here is the brightest sample that LED had over twelve seconds. Every LED comes up lit and then holds
# at full for seconds before it starts to fade, so its brightest sample is its colour undimmed and
# exact - and that colour never changes, because the sequence it comes from is redrawn identically
# every frame. So this is the colour sequence itself, with the twinkling divided out. Hex RGB
# triples, wire order.
